response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and leadership in open-source projects, but lacks direct experience with C++ (a minimum requirement) and large-scale cloud compute infrastructure. His background in mentoring and technical leadership is a positive, though his experience is more aligned with web/mobile development and developer tooling than the core requirements of this role.
strengths: Proven technical leadership and mentoring experience through workshops, talks, and open-source contributions.
Diverse technical background with exposure to distributed systems, real-time data processing, and infrastructure (e.g., Kubernetes, DLang for low-latency apps).
Strong problem-solving skills and experience with software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, architectural patterns).
concerns: No explicit experience with C++ (8 years required), a critical gap for this role.
Limited direct experience with cloud compute platforms or large-scale infrastructure (preferred qualifications).
Most recent roles focus on full-stack/web development, not the specialized cloud compute or hardware-adjacent systems emphasized in the job description.
